About

Hi there, I'm Prisha! 👋

I'm a junior studying Computer Science and Mathematics at UIUC, with a minor in Statistics. I like turning messy problems, in code, data, or systems, into ones I can actually solve.

I've always loved problem solving, algorithms, and finding my way through a puzzle. When I was younger that meant memorizing algorithms for my Rubik's cube, working through sliding puzzle games, and grinding out 2048 until I hit 8192. These days it looks more like the CS work below, or on a slower night, NYT Games, LinkedIn's puzzles, Flow, Mastermind, and pretty much any crossword I can get my hands on. That's the thread this whole site is built around, so feel free to click around and get to know me.
